This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing and submitted no solve job. I checked `list_models` and the project; the project has no revisions.

What is missing:
- **Steam property method:** the case needs an IAPWS-95 Helmholtz water model (`fs.prop_water`) with enthalpy-pressure state variables and liquid/vapor mixed-phase handling. No such route is offered, and the c1 and syn001 models don't declare any steam property package.
- **Turbine stages:** the case uses 11 `HelmTurbineStageData` stages (`fs.turbine[1]` to `fs.turbine[11]`) plus a feed-pump drive turbine (`fs.bfpt`). There is no expander or turbine model.
- **Steam splitters:** the case uses 10 `HelmSplitterData` extraction splitters (`fs.turbine_splitter[1]` to `[10]`). The only splitter, `c1.stream_splitter`, has fixed "recycle" and "purge" outlets and no 3-way version, so it can't stand in for them.
- **Helmholtz mixers:** the case needs mixers with `momentum_mixing_type: minimize` (`fs.fwh_mixer[*]`, `fs.deaerator`, `fs.condenser_mix`). The available adiabatic mixers allow no pressure drop and have no "minimize" pressure option.
- **Compressors and pumps:** the case needs isentropic Helmholtz compressors with a pressure change (`fs.cond_pump`, `fs.booster`, `fs.bfp`). The case's feed-pump turbine drives the boiler feed pump shaft, a work-sharing link that isn't offered. `syn001.liquid_pump` is a liquid pump with a given efficiency and no steam property route, so I didn't use it as a stand-in.
- **Heat exchangers and heaters:** the case needs `HeatExchangerData` feedwater heaters (`fs.fwh[1]` to `[9]`) and reheaters with pressure change. The case's `fs.boiler` and `fs.reheater[*]` heaters also use `has_pressure_change: true`, and the available heaters require zero pressure drop. The available `syn001.heat_exchanger` has no steam property route and no underwood ΔT callback.
- **Steady state:** the case's solve specification says `steady_state: false`, and this version only offers steady-state solves.

Substituting other units or a different property method would not represent the case, so I didn't build a substitute.

The case's solve specification also states steady_state false. No faithful representation is possible, so nothing was built."}, "claims": []}
